_doc: Curated Chalice Glyphs for the Ritual Altar's pick list (bbport.ini party_glyph_list). A glyph is only a lookup key: the dungeon's layout (FormData) lived on FromSoftware's servers, and the party has no server. An entry is offered only when it carries its layout in "form" (the base64 FormData of a dungeon, as the party board holds it); without "form" it cannot be entered and is skipped. Entry: {"glyph": 8 letters/digits, "name": text, "depth": 1-5, "area": text, "notes": text, "form": base64}. Add entries here; nothing else is needed.
